notes.title: Known Issues & Bug Report Feature Added
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/644fc070219560b422ee9f7a0c41df051078ac7d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, this is the Fishing Online team.[/p][p]The most frequently reported issue so far has been account access failures and login errors.[/p][p][/p][p]Upon investigation, it has been confirmed that the login issues may occur if a Steam account ID contains special characters.[/p][p]This issue can occur regardless of the account’s language setting (Korean, English, etc.).[/p][p]Please be noted that we have already applied a hotfix and completed the improvement.[/p][p][/p][p]If the same issue persists, please contact us via the Steam Community or the official Discord channel.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also added a bug report feature to help you submit any issues you encounter during gameplay. To use this feature, tap the [b]“Feedback”[/b] button at the bottom of the screen, then select the [b]“Bug Report”[/b] button.[/p][p]Please note that the [b][u]game will temporarily close[/u][/b] to launch the bug report system — this is an intended behavior, so there’s no need to worry. After entering the title and details of the bug and pressing [b]SEND[/b], information about the situation will be securely sent to our server. Rest assured, no personal or sensitive information will ever be transmitted.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/a894384a9a71a87e2ee31c5703d485a2d890e410.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As always, thank you for your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Fishing Online Official Release
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/51607254cee48d095c8979ee0e1924a485f6b671.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, this is the Fishing Online team.
Through the humble act of fishing, we hoped to create a game where players could reel in new worlds, people, and a range of emotions.
Now, under the title of “Official Release,” we embark on our first voyage on Steam.

[b]Official Release Schedule[/b]
· July 30, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC)

[b]The World We Want to Create Together[/b]
Fishing Online is more than just a fishing game.
It’s a small world that anyone can enjoy in their own way.
And this small world isfilled with:
· Player-to-player interactions
· Exploring new fishing spots
· Customizing your own aquarium[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/137923a8932a2904be8ae5c44f1cc76e2c5ef86d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/a9308ad704cf7a988f6a8e64bbeb688c1506070d.png"][/img][/carousel][p]· Hundreds of unique fish species[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/89b026896daa4e41fa875601d4cf2360e41bdfc9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/6eace4af935ecdd3d3ea11de59189770aa46b554.png"][/img][/p][p]When your imagination meets ours, this world can become a small universe of its own.

[b]A New Take on Nostalgia[/b] 
Fishing Online began as an homage to the fishing games of the past.
But rather than just a simple revival—it is a reinterpretation using today’s modern sensibilities and technology.
Experience features such as:
· The Boss Fish in each map
· Timing-based action battles
· Collection systems and ranking competitions
· Camping and social features
All of these are our way of carrying the torch of the charm of classic fishing games.

[b]A Pleasant Surprise[/b] 
As this is an early version, some systems may not yet be fully polished.
That also means you might discover rare items or surprises in unexpected ways.
We believe this moment is your chance to craft a fishing journey that's truly your own.
In a world free from rigid rules, enjoy the journey however you please.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/9fbced62b39dd9656cb449b0bbbf4fc37fca9df6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/4ac70cda6a3ea0e9e4b2e3813aea91b19e11c625.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/e81c31f9dcf5245bc802de676571bf47c199d166.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/a51f961685bb8856e4628a70e1e0bb0ec6803080.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/93589a6bcecd9b6438adbc3ce7ebe49110123302.png"][/img][/p][p][b]User-Driven Improvements[/b][/p][p]Fishing Online is a game built with emotion and imagination.[/p][p]We understand it might not appeal to everyone’s taste, which is why your feedback is invaluable to us.[/p][p]We will continue to reflect diverse opinions and develop a game that embraces its unique identity.

[b]Future Plans[/b]
· Weekly bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements
· Quarterly content updates and roadmap releases
· Paid store update in August
· Real-name system implementation based on community suggestions
· Active reflection of global user feedback

[b]A World Built Together[/b]
The Fishing Online team has been creating a small online world centered around the experience of fishing.
As a small team, we’ve come this far slowly but sincerely.
There’s still room for improvement, but we believe this moment is not the end, but a new beginning.

We want to show that “this game is alive,” and we hope to achieve this together with you.
We are ready to keep communicating, listening, and growing together.

Thank you for reading all the way to the end.
We are committed to delivering better content and services, slowly but steadily.
We sincerely appreciate your valuable feedback and ongoing support.
Thank you.
* Fishing Online Official Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Cw7tTZ9DZM"]https://discord.gg/Cw7tTZ9DZM[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
Hello, Fishers!

As some of you may know, some countries in the East use the lunar calendar along with the Gregorian calendar. And February 10th is the Lunar New Year. Originally, we wanted to introduce a more refined version of Fishing Online before the New Year, but due to a slight delay in our schedule, it seems we will be able to show you the updated version in mid-February. With this version, you will be able to see the addition of more fishing battles and the harvesting feature that adds variation to the monotony.

Fishing Online is not based on general reel fishing, but rather on freshwater fishing with rod fishing. Of course, someday we plan to expand the genre to include reel fishing, sea fishing, boat fishing, and more, but for now, we are focusing on freshwater fishing. This style of fishing may feel a bit unfamiliar, but we believe it can offer a different kind of excitement. And we want to bring you enjoyment through its gradual growth and development.

Fishing involves preparing equipment, baiting the hook, casting, then hooking based on the bite, and struggling with the fish. Finally, you come face-to-face with the opponent you've been struggling against. And to continue fishing, you collect bait, and during this process, you cook using the vegetables and other items you gather. We are continuously working to create and complete the most ideal environment for this cycle to function(Perhaps one day, you might meet a street cat longing for fish and end up sharing a bond of closeness with them).

We are aware that there are still many areas lacking. And the final product may not perfectly match what you envision. However, we are committed to best integrating fishing, gaming, and the online genre. We continue to listen to your opinions throughout the development process. We are paying attention to each and every one of your requests. We ask for your active participation and feedback. Your logically approached thoughts and opinions can also greatly help in narrowing the differences among our developers.

During the process of conducting this Early access, there have been meetings with several developers who wish to participate in development. We are exploring positive directions that allow for gradual and faster development and working on various things. Please continue to watch us with interest, and we will strive to put more effort into development.

Anyway, I wish you all a very happy New Year, AGAIN.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730559/4ef17abf3042169a928e2f3c85b456e8f805fcb0.png[/img]
